routes.description: A file containing a list of routes, one on each line.

prerenderedRoutes.description: The path to `prerendered-routes.json` generated by an Angular prerender.

domain.description: The domain to use for the sitemap URLs.

baseUrl.description: An optional base URL under which the sitemaps will be served. Defaults to '/'.

output.description: The folder on disk in which to store the generated sitemaps.
